newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon guerrillas ambush pro-Israeli militiamen.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon guerrillas ambush pro-Israeli militiamen.

text.p: Geurrillas attacked an Israeli-backed militia patrol in south Lebanon on Saturday but there were no casualties, pro-Israeli militia sources said.

The sources had said hours earlier that a South Lebanon Army (SLA) militiaman was killed when his patrol came under guerrilla fire near the village of Markaba in Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
"The initial report from the patrol said that one member was killed in the ambush but later it turned out that he was only unconscious," one SLA source said.

No group immediately claimed responsibility for the attack but pro-Iranian and Syrian-backed guerrillas wage attacks against Israeli and SLA forces in a bid to drive them out from the south Lebanon zone they hold since 1985.
